name: DhirDhar v3.0.0
changelog:
DhirDhar v3.0.0 Release Notes:

### Navigation & Workflow Unification
- Consolidated Ledger: Merged Borrowers, Reports, and interest ledger access directly under the unified Ledger navigation.
- Clean Navigation Sidebar: Streamlined primary workflow access while preserving all underlying transaction routes, search indexing, and keyboard navigation shortcuts.

### Financial Calculation & Ledger Precision
- Exact 9-Column Presentation: Displays Date | Principal | Withdrawal | Deposit | Interest Rate | Per Month | Days | Interest | Running Balance across both Borrowers and Outsource accounts.
- Event-Date Anchored Sequencing: Every financial event resets and anchors calculation sequences strictly from its event date without reverting to original loan dates.
- Individual Monthly Rows: Each complete interest month displays cleanly as an individual record with exact date-to-date anniversary mapping.
- Standardized Duration Formatting: Uses clear English duration indicators (Y, M, D) consistently across all localized interface settings.

### Enterprise Security & Architecture
- Standalone Production Package: Hardened single-file installer (DhirDhar-3.0.0-x64-Setup.exe) compiled with LZMA2 ultra-compression.
- Authenticode Signed: Production binaries and setup executable signed with authenticated cryptographic certificates.
- Application Integrity: Runtime HMAC-SHA256 signature verification with zero unauthenticated binary execution.
- Full Verification: 1,685 automated tests passing with 100% pass rate across Domain, Application, and Infrastructure layers.
